summary: Package ships a Go-compiled remote-shell agent with hardcoded WebSocket C2 relay
details: The tarball contains a single Mach-O binary bin/sxt (~13MB, Go) that embeds a remote-control agent combining github.com/coder/websocket, github.com/creack/pty, and the full github.com/pion/webrtc/v4 stack (datachannel/ice/dtls/sctp/turn). The binary embeds a hardcoded WebSocket relay wss://relay.sextant.top, references to /bin/claude and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, and an ip-api.com geolocation URL (http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,query) used to fingerprint the host. The combination of an outbound WebSocket to an author-controlled relay, a PTY, and a WebRTC datachannel gives a remote party interactive command execution on the installer's macOS host. The package.json declares no main, no bin, and no lifecycle scripts, and its license field is 'SEE LICENSE IN https://github.com/ddos798/claude_control' — the repo slug directly names the binary's function (remote control of local Claude/Gemini CLIs).

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
